This form is how you show us what you built. Fill it as you work. We verify every claim, so be precise.
1_Your_Details: your contact details and all links.
2_Must_haves: mark each must-have Yes or No with evidence. Every one must pass to be selected.
3_Levels: mark each item Yes / Partial / No with evidence. The level you reached is calculated for you.
4_Integration: mark each Integration Standard point with evidence.
5_Metrics: enter your measured numbers.  6_Hard_cases: say how your system handles each situation.
Save as Assessment4_YourName.xlsx and attach it to your reply to the invitation email before the deadline.
Colour key: YELLOW = you fill in.  GREEN = calculated automatically.  GREY = instructions or example.
Your self-check (updates as you fill the form)

We then verify your claims and add up to 20 marks for 5 hidden tests (screening total 80). Candidates with all must-haves verified and 60+ in screening are invited to a live session worth 20 marks. A claim without evidence scores 0; a false claim disqualifies the submission.

Local test instances. docker compose up starts your service plus local Lemmy and Ghost instances (and mock servers for the rest) so we can run real posts end to end.

values: Yes = fully meets it (2), Partial = partly (1), No = missing (0).

docker compose up starts the service and everything it needs (database, storage, local test servers). One command runs all tests (unit, integration and at least one end-to-end) with no API keys. A .env.example lists every setting.
An openapi.yaml (OpenAPI 3.1) that matches the running service exactly. All routes under /api/v1/.

Anything slower than 2 seconds runs as a job: POST returns 202 with a job_id; GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id} returns status (queued, running, succeeded, failed), progress 0-100 and result links. Optional callback URL, signed with HMAC-SHA256 in an X-IncuBrix-Signature header.
An Idempotency-Key header on every POST: sending the same request twice with the same key returns the same job and never does the work twice.
Errors are JSON: {"error": {"code", "message", "retryable", "details"}}. Codes are UPPER_SNAKE_CASE and listed in the README.
All settings, paths, model names and limits come from environment variables or a config file. No hard-coded paths or keys.
Inputs accepted as an upload or a URL. Outputs saved to S3-compatible storage (MinIO in the compose file is fine) and returned as download links.
Structured JSON logs with timestamp, level, job_id and the X-Correlation-Id from the request. GET /health and GET /ready endpoints.
Every result includes a JSON manifest: which models/providers and versions were used, settings, seed, timings, cost estimate, warnings, and licence/rights information.
A command-line tool that runs a folder or file of test inputs against the API and writes all results to one folder. We use this to test every submission the same way.

values: For each situation, say what your system does and link to the test output. We will run 5 hidden tests of these kinds.
A publish call that times out and is retried with the same idempotency key.
Same-key replay is idempotent, and an expired ambiguous publish is blocked. No forced external timeout/retry run.
A 429 response with a reset time; an expired token; content rejected by the platform.
Shared error handling exists. The full 429, expired-token, and platform-rejection case is not tested end to end.
A title or body longer than the destination allows; media the destination does not accept.
Length limits are applied; unsupported-media behavior is not demonstrated for every connector.
A second post inside a destination's frequency cap; a promotional post to a community that bans self-promotion.
Frequency cap and promotional prohibition are tested before publish.
A platform that renames a field in its API: certification must fail and the destination must be demoted.
No API field-rename failure and demotion test is recorded.
A CSV with duplicates, bad URLs and mixed languages; a partner who revokes permission.
CSV duplicate and invalid-row cases are tested; mixed-language and revoked-permission coverage is incomplete.
A non-English community; a destination that requires AI-content disclosure.
AI disclosure is tested; non-English community behavior is not demonstrated.
